title: Another Word for Traffic Jam: 3 English Words #shorts
description:
The traffic isn’t just slow. Here are 3 better ways to talk about a traffic jam:
• Stuck in traffic: unable to move because there are too many cars
• Bumper-to-bumper: very close together and moving slowly
• Gridlock: traffic so bad that nothing moves at all

Which one is your Monday morning?

Clip: Two Tars (1928)
